O1.name: Functional completeness

applicability.rule: Scores whenever the grading phase ran, over every in-scope milestone regardless of status. Every milestone of the run's scope stays in the denominator: non-green milestones (capability-failure, aborted, blocked, not-run) score their checklists as not passed - the status distinction matters for attribution, not for completeness credit. A milestone adjudicated capability-failure for a dishonest coverage mapping scores its checklist not-passed.

O1.reducedRunNote: On reduced runs anchors are interpreted over M1-M3 scope only: the 60-anchor reads 'M1-M2 solid, M3 patchy'.

applicability.rule: Scores whenever the grading phase ran (severity-weighted defects found beyond the checklist), over every in-scope milestone regardless of status.

Requires M6 green plus M1-M5 attempted (green/capability-failure/aborted). Otherwise null. Scored from the wave's secret rotated holdout probes only; anchor probes are non-scored continuity diagnostics and never bear on O3.
Requires M6 green. Otherwise null. Scored from the harness's mechanically checkable simulator choreography artifacts (recordings plus structured receipts), never from builder assertions.

Requires the scale replay *attempted*. Its exact function scores failures, including its 0 branches, so an attempted replay is never null. Never-attempted replay records null. A scale-safety gate mapped by an exact function of the frozen invariants; bands evaluate first-match in the order 0, 30, 60, 90, 75; the rubric-wide 'interpolate' instruction does not apply to O5.

bandFunction.0: invariant manifest does not conform (including a named-fixture mismatch) OR replay's wall cap was exhausted
bandFunction.30: any degradation rule fails OR any probe times out/errors/OOMs
bandFunction.60: all rules pass but any absolute ceiling is exceeded OR replay used >80% of its cap
bandFunction.90: every probe's observed ceiling utilization is <=50% AND replay used <=50% of its cap
bandFunction.75: otherwise (all rules and ceilings pass, 90's condition not met)

completeLane.definition: Execution completeness, by enumeration: M6 green, the scale replay attempted, M7 attempted, and every other milestone (M1-M5) attempted.
completeLane.notes: The published completion rate counts execution completeness; total-eligibility is reported beside it. L4 statistics read complete lanes only, with every lane reported and the completion rate published alongside, so no survivor bias is hidden.

usableGradingRecord.definition: A weighted total and L4 eligibility additionally require a usable grading record. The dual grader-abort outcome (D3.4: grader re-runs once, second failure records grader-abort, other-family regrade, and that regrade also aborts) nulls the O-dimensions and OVERRIDES these applicability rules - the lane is excluded from claim statistics while still being reported. A lane regraded by the builder's own family is labeled same-family-graded in the record and any publication.

nullDimensionRule: Any run with a null dimension publishes per-dimension scores and efficiency statistics only - no overall weighted total (LLP 0198 P0.0(e)'s bar on averaging unexercised dimensions). The Holistic section's 'report both' applies only when a weighted total exists.
holisticScore: Recorded and published for every run as narrative evidence, never a claim statistic; recorded before the builder computes or sees the weighted total, citing 2-3 concrete moments.
